NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 31, 10:43 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 21.8 DraftKings points for $8,600, against the Chargers. CeeDee Lamb (20.7, $8,100) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.4, $8,000) are next.

Wan'Dale Robinson returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.86 projected points per $1,000 at $4,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 31, 10:43 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 8

Puka Nacua, LAR vs LAC ($8,600)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.8 DraftKings points at $8,600, the 5th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.1 points clear of CeeDee Lamb. The model gives him 10.6 targets on 30.2 routes. The salary works out to 2.53 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 46.2, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 45.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs ARI ($8,100)

CeeDee Lamb projects 2nd at the position with 20.7 DraftKings points at $8,100. The model gives him 9.6 targets on 33.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.56 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 7.5 and a ceiling of 43.4, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30.75 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs MIN ($8,000)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 3rd at the position with 18.4 DraftKings points at $8,000. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 32.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.29 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 43.3, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Wan'Dale Robinson, TEN at CIN ($4,200)

Wan'Dale Robinson projects for 12.0 DraftKings points at $4,200, which works out to 2.86 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 34 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 9.7 targets on 30.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 11.9 points with a simulated floor of 0.3 and a ceiling of 38.2, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 12.5-point underdog on the road against Cincinnati, with an implied team total of 17 in a game totaled at 46.5.
